findings.affected_contract: Bounded taxonomy-list query scalability; SQL statistics aggregates are a separate fixed-query path.
findings.reproduction: Create four synthetic canonical taxonomy rows. Instrument the real SQLAlchemy engine; call list(page_size=1), then list(page_size=4) under the same tenant/read grant. See review_probes.py.
findings.expected_result: Batch selected-version and actor projections so query count does not grow linearly with page size.
findings.impact: Three per-row reads add network/database latency. Page size is capped at 100; no cross-tenant leak, wrong count or measured acceptance timeout resulted.
findings.recommended_fix: In a separately validated change, load selected versions and creator/latest actor projections with bounded batch queries; preserve payload, tenant scope and stable order.
findings.regression_test: test_taxonomy_list_query_growth_is_measured reproduces 5 vs 14 statements; future regression should assert constant bounded query count and unchanged response semantics.
findings.merge_blocking_assessment: No stated latency SLA is violated in measurements; bounded administrative list, not a correctness/security failure. Formal reviewer must assess this deferral.

findings.affected_contract: Reconstruction of historical native-tool binary environment from Git alone.
findings.reproduction: Inspect FROM debian:trixie-slim and unversioned apt-get install package names; rebuild with the repository helper and record the newly produced immutable image ID.
findings.expected_result: A release reproducibility policy should pin a reviewed base digest and package snapshot or retain an independently identified image/SBOM.
findings.impact: Git/source digest alone cannot reconstruct the identical historical tool image; package updates can alter later parser/scanner behavior. Existing executed image IDs, source hashes, signed Debian installation and CVD signature verification remain valid traceability evidence. No compromised package is alleged.
findings.recommended_fix: Define an approved immutable image retention and patch-refresh policy; pin reviewed base/package provenance and record SBOM/tool versions before production acceptance. Revalidate any resulting source/image change.
findings.regression_test: Actual bounded sandbox probe passes; build helper records image/source digests. A future reproducibility gate should verify approved image/package provenance.
findings.merge_blocking_assessment: Each technical run uses a concrete sha256 image and signed tool installation. Production deployment remains explicitly NOT ACCEPTED; no change is made solely to manufacture a clean findings register. Formal reviewer must assess the residual risk.
